summary: Ran the strategy end to end: the driver's sweep was green and not re-run, and I verified the work itself — the real `writeVersionPins` body and its emitted shell executed against a local bare remote (one commit, exactly the 7 pin lines per file, a repeat run pushes nothing, every guard throws, the token is in neither the console nor the history), the chart's missing-pin guards (14/14 renders refused naming the key), the gate (17 mutations, none blind), all seven vars/*.groovy through groovy-all 2.4.21 and groovy-cps 1.31's CpsTransformer, the registry (dev-523 held for all seven; 523/prd-523 are the accepted forward references) and the register/slice-012 edits: 11 of 12 verification items pass, one comment-only fix was committed (JenkinsPipelineUtils 2c43b06), and KubeCoderDeploy 49f0629, JenkinsPipelineUtils 2c43b06 and AnsibleSpecs 08c962c are pushed (Ansible has no slice commits, so no iac-on-push run applies). Deploy-owed: nothing to apply, since no role, playbook, inventory or Terraform module changed; the one item owed to the operator is V04, Ruling 2's canary — Build Now on https://jenkins.webathome.org/job/AaC/job/Ansible/ and hand back the console, which must show `Resolved main as branch main at revision 2c43b0694cd94e66942644b9504d4690bed44f38` and finish SUCCESS (close-out A1).
